856-5776-6277-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.

1479-2841-4677-8099.easyPrerequisites:

Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.

Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.

Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.

Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.

When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

1909-3443-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.

Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.

Play any Island except Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers, allowing you to draw a card.

When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Aesi trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw three cards.

Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.

Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Shipwreck Dowser and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Ayula.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ayula trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
